input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Polish: hub hero shows close crops of each tool's drawing (hero-art 'Still weakest' item 1)
errors: Started the first site build with a shell '&', which outlived its subshell; the second, properly backgrounded build refused (dist.building lock) and the DONE marker never appeared, so I waited on the pid instead.
Ran the pages suite while the new post's description was 163 characters; 164 tests failed on that one cause. Trimmed it and reran: all green.

doc_friction.issue: Says to screenshot the hub, but a screenshot under ~1.5 s catches the stat tiles counting up and looks like a count mismatch; two runs in a row (story-cards and this one) chased it. Worth a line in the prompt or platform/pages/README.md.

Header says to serve dist with python3 http.server and import 'playwright'; in the cloud container the bare import fails, so PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE=/opt/node-tools/node_modules/playwright/index.js is needed (the env hook existed but the header did not say so; fixed in this PR).

notes: Built the site (check.mjs: 10,632 pages, no dead links, before and after). Surveyed hub, flagship (wall-framing-takeoff, ai-bookkeeper), research index, Stories, a post and the tools topic at 390/1,280. Hero card text 3.7 px -> 6.7 px (1.8x), hero image bytes 102,912 -> 65,824. node --test showcase.test.mjs 12/12; node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs': 1,739/1,739 pass (a first run failed 164 tests, all from the post's 163-character description, since trimmed).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: survey of six surfaces, capture-script crop feature with tests, rebuild and measurement, report and post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
